$comment: The Careers page and its navigation labels. AUTHORED, not generated — like companies.json, no script writes this file, so it survives `npm run ingest` and is safe to hand-edit.
$comment_placeholder: HR has not supplied copy yet. The body below is deliberately minimal, factual scaffolding — NOT proposed employer-brand wording — and the page is emitted with placeholder:true, so it renders `noindex, follow`, stays out of sitemap.xml, and keeps appearing in the ingest's 'must not go live as-is' list until real copy replaces it. Replace `body` and drop nothing else; the flag clears itself once the copy is long enough to be real.

body.en:
3Lines Advanced Technologies Company employs a multidisciplinary team across supply chain, maintenance, repair and manufacturing, supporting defense and advanced technology programmes in the Kingdom.

Role listings and application details will be published here.
body.ar:
توظّف شركة ثريلاينز آدفانسد تكنولجيز فريقًا متعدد التخصصات في مجالات سلاسل الإمداد والصيانة والإصلاح والتصنيع، دعمًا لبرامج الدفاع والتقنيات المتقدمة داخل المملكة.

سيتم نشر الوظائف الشاغرة وتفاصيل التقديم هنا.

$comment_cta: Until there is an application route, the page points at the existing contact form rather than inventing one.
